name: Medicine
description: The MD degree — four years of professional doctorate, then residency. ⚠⚠ Six Florida public institutions award it and they produced 757 credentials in 2023, 749 of them professional doctorates: USF 179, UF 149, FSU 125, UCF 122, FIU 118, FAU 64. ⚠⚠⚠ And there is no undergraduate major requirement anywhere in the process — AAMC's own data shows the three majors with the HIGHEST acceptance rates are mathematics, humanities and the physical sciences.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠⚠ THERE IS NO PRE-MED MAJOR, AND THE DATA SAYS CHOOSING ONE THAT SOUNDS MEDICAL IS THE WORST OPTION. AAMC Table A-17 for academic year 2025-26 records 54,699 applicants and 23,440 matriculants — an overall rate of 42.9%. By major group: mathematics and statistics 57.3%, humanities 52.0%, physical sciences 51.3%, social sciences 42.3%, biological sciences 42.1%, other 40.7%, and ⚠⚠ SPECIALIZED HEALTH SCIENCES 40.3% — the lowest in the table. ⚠ Biological sciences supplies 32,038 of the 54,699 applicants, 58.6% of the field, at a below-average rate. ⚠⚠⚠ Read the caution with the finding: these are selection effects and the small groups are self-selected — mathematics and statistics is only 335 applicants. And MATRICULANT scores CONVERGE (biological sciences 511.9 total MCAT, humanities 513.0, all matriculants 512.1), so the bar is the same everywhere; what differs is who clears it. ⚠ The honest claim is narrow: the data gives no support to choosing a major BECAUSE it sounds medical. ⚠⚠ WHAT IS ACTUALLY REQUIRED is the prerequisite COURSEWORK, not a major — general biology with laboratory, general and organic chemistry with laboratories, biochemistry, physics with laboratory, mathematics through calculus or statistics, psychology, sociology and composition. Florida's public colleges carry all of it, most at 15 to 39 institutions. ⚠⚠⚠ The exception is BCH3023 Biochemistry, carried by only SEVEN institutions and upper division — the one prerequisite likely to force a transfer.

cips.note: Medicine (MD) — 6 Florida public institutions and 757 credentials in 2023, 749 of them professional doctorates. University of South Florida 179, University of Florida 149, Florida State 125, University of Central Florida 122, Florida International 118, Florida Atlantic 64. ⚠ Public institutions only; this site does not list Florida's private and osteopathic medical schools.

related.note: ⚠⚠ The comparison most pre-medical students eventually make, and it should be made on structure rather than prestige. Two to three years against four plus a residency of three to seven, and a PA can change specialty without retraining where a physician cannot. ⚠ Six Florida public PA programmes against six medical schools — the same number, very different lengths.

⚠⚠⚠ Named because of one striking comparison: nurse anesthetists number 53,800 nationally against 45,300 anesthesiologists, with 2,700 annual openings against 1,300. ⚠ The nursing occupation is LARGER than the physician one it works alongside, and reaching it takes an RN licence plus a doctorate rather than medical school plus a four-year residency.

⚠ The MD/MPH is a common combination and public health is where a substantial share of physicians end up working on policy, epidemiology and population programmes. ⚠⚠ Florida teaches it at 8 institutions, all universities, with 579 master's degrees a year.

⚠ Not a route into medicine, but an increasingly common route out of clinical practice: physician executives are counted inside the medical and health services manager occupation. ⚠⚠ Named because a student weighing a twelve-year training path should know what the exits look like.

⚠ Named as one of the honest alternatives rather than a route. It uses the same chemistry and biology prerequisites, is a licensed profession in Florida, reaches $82,280 on a bachelor's, and takes four years rather than twelve. ⚠⚠ A student who loves the science but not the twelve years should look at it before deciding.
